name: Stop Motion: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Stop Motion look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, stop-motion puppet animation still, handmade clay and felt puppets with visible fingerprints and stitching, miniature set built from real materials, small practical lamps, shallow depth of field of a macro lens, warm tabletop lighting
negative_prompt: smooth cgi, photorealistic human, flat 2d, digital gloss, motion blur, text, watermark
